thesis: AI 代理滲透一切，系統性安全治理才剛起步
thesis_en: AI agents are everywhere; systematic safety governance is just beginning
thesis_note: 今日有三個訊號指向同一張力：Meta 把 Muse 代理嵌入家居硬體設備、Instinct 等代理直接在簡訊裡替消費者決策、DeepSeek 正大規模擴容 Agent 訓練基礎設施。與此同時，OpenAI 安全負責人辭職批評「試誤式安全文化」、Apple 收緊 AI 代理的磁碟存取權限——代理化的速度遠超過治理框架的建立速度。對行銷人員的意義：AI 中介層已介入消費者決策路徑，觸達規則尚未定案，現在是設定代理策略與內部授權框架的關鍵時間窗口。
thesis_note_en: Three signals today point to the same tension: Meta embeds Muse agents into home hardware, Instinct-type agents handle consumer purchases via SMS, and DeepSeek is scaling Agent training infrastructure at pace. Meanwhile, an OpenAI safety leader resigns citing a 'culture of trial-and-error', and Apple clamps down on AI agent disk access — agentification is moving far faster than governance. For marketers: AI intermediaries are already entering consumer decision paths, the rules of engagement haven't been set, and this is the critical window to define your agent strategy and internal authorisation framework.
